text: Covering one day after the other, one day after the other, we have come to the closing day of the 10 days Thamma seminar. When you started your work, you surrendered yourself, surrendered to this technique. It was very essential. Otherwise one does not give fair trial to the technique. One joins a camp like this to give a trial to the technique, to give full justice to the technique.
